Projects

  • Motorheart github.com/tevans-3/motorheart

    An animation of a DC motor's internal h-bridge circuit (the motor's 'heart'), driven by a real DC motor operating in locked anti-phase mode and controlled by a Pi Pico 2W. PWM varies the duty cycle to control rotation speed; the pot scale is divided into three zones. Pot readings below 45% reference voltage drive CW, above 55%, CCW, and between, neutral.

  • Firepi tevans-3.github.io/posts/firepi

    A visualization of firefly synchronization using a Raspberry Pi Pico and an addressable WS2812B LED ring.

  • Reversible Game of Life tevans-3.github.io/posts/life

    A Game of Life animation using thermistors to set cell initialization randomness, an LED matrix for animation, and a Pi Pico for control. CW potentiometer turns drive generations; each CCW turn reverses the board back to the previous generation.

  • Evil Cube github.com/tevans-3/evil-cube

    An adversarial Rubik's cube: a Rubik's cube that fights back. The cube scrambles itself whenever you get within a certain number of steps from solving it. It estimates the number of remaining solve-steps using corner pattern database lookups.

  • Synesthesia visualnoise.ca

    Color-picker sonification maps user-picked hexcodes to 24 tone-equal-temperament chords with in-browser playback
